description: Normalises OpenAI-compatible SSE streams so a content or reasoning delta that arrives after the finish reason cannot kill a session ("OpenAI Chat received content after the finish reason"). A stream the gateway cuts mid-generation is left unterminated — n

detail.description_zh: 规范化与 OpenAI 兼容的 SSE 流，以便在完成原因之后到达的内容或推理增量不会终止会话（“OpenAI 聊天在完成原因之后接收到内容”）。网关在生成中途切断的流将保持未终止状态 — n
